description: Source code for Renesas RA GPIO driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO configuration, interrupt handling, and register access functions.

methods.name: gpio_ra_irq_info_event
methods.description: Extracts event information from gpio_ra_irq_info flags.

methods.name: gpio_ra_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO port interrupts, fires callbacks and clears interrupt flags.

methods.name: query_irq_info
methods.description: Finds irq info for a specific pin from configuration.

methods.name: reg_read
methods.description: Reads 32-bit value from GPIO register at specified offset.

methods.name: reg_write
methods.description: Writes 32-bit value to GPIO register at specified offset.

methods.name: port_write
methods.description: Writes value to port with mask.

methods.name: gpio_ra_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, sets up interrupts if enabled.

methods.name: gpio_ra_pin_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_ra_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt for a GPIO pin.
